info.title: TokenIQ API
info.description: Treasury intelligence and operations. USD values are decimal strings; raw token amounts are integer strings.

get.description: Reports measured provider health from TokenIQ's own checks. Components that have never been checked are reported as unknown, never as operational.

get.summary: Treasury overview: balances, reserve requirement, deployable surplus, projection
get.description: Every figure is computed by the deterministic engine from stored on-chain observations. `reserve.uncertainty` lists reasons the figures may be incomplete.

get.summary: Daily stablecoin balance history reconstructed from stored snapshots
get.description: Uses the last observation of each day per account and asset. Days before TokenIQ started observing an account are absent, not zero.

post.summary: Run a stress scenario without changing any data

post.summary: Record an obligation

get.summary: Upcoming and overdue occurrences with payment status
Obligation with upcoming occurrences, payments and documents

post.summary: Add a Safe or wallet (read-only until verified)
post.description: TokenIQ reads the address on-chain to detect whether it is a Safe, a contract or an externally owned account. Added accounts are watch-only and excluded from reserve maths until a member proves control by signing a challenge.

patch.summary: Rename, change purpose, or include/exclude from treasury maths

delete.summary: Stop tracking an account (history is kept)

post.summary: Read balances now
Get a message to sign proving control of the account
post.description: For a Safe, the signer must be a current owner. For a wallet, the signer must be the wallet itself. The message is single-use, bound to this organization, account and signer, and expires in 10 minutes.

post.summary: Submit the signed challenge
Record an obligation occurrence as paid (optionally verified on-chain) or skipped
post.description: With a transaction hash, TokenIQ decodes the receipt's Transfer logs: `paid_verified` requires the asset to reach the obligation's recipient (and, for USD obligations paid in USD stablecoins, at least the obligation amount) with enough confirmations. Without a hash the payment is recorded as `paid_unverified` (someone says it was paid).

post.summary: Re-check an unverified payment on-chain

delete.summary: Undo a payment record that is not verified on-chain

get.summary: Capital venues with suitability against your policy
get.description: APY figures are measurements from the named source at `source.fetchedAt`; they are not promises. `listed` venues passed TokenIQ's integration review and are the only ones that can become proposals.

get.summary: Open recommendations (recomputed from current data on every request)

post.summary: Dismiss a recommendation with a reason
Create a proposal from a recommendation or a structured action
post.description: The action is re-validated by the deterministic policy engine against current data. Invalid actions are rejected with the failing checks. Creating a proposal never moves funds: it starts internal approval, after which Safe owners must sign in their own wallets.

get.summary: Proposal with approvals, signatures, executions and a fresh policy check

post.summary: Approve or reject (internal approval; not a Safe signature)
Comment on a proposal
Cancel a proposal that has not been submitted on-chain
Build and simulate the Safe transaction owners will sign
post.description: Re-validates the action with fresh data, reads the Safe live (version, owners, threshold, nonce), builds calldata from code-defined addresses only, computes the EIP-712 safeTxHash and simulates it via Safe's simulateAndRevert. Changing the nonce or calldata invalidates previous signatures.

post.summary: Submit a Safe owner's signature over the safeTxHash
post.description: The signer is recovered from the signature and must be a current owner of the Safe (read on-chain). TokenIQ stores the signature; it never holds keys.

post.summary: Calldata for execTransaction with collected signatures (any wallet may submit it)
Record a submitted execution transaction hash for tracking
post.description: Submitting is not success: the proposal becomes `submitted` and a background job tracks the receipt, the Safe's ExecutionSuccess/ExecutionFailure event and confirmations.

post.summary: Acknowledge an alert
Mark all notifications read

get.summary: Point-in-time treasury snapshot for printable summaries
get.description: Generated from TokenIQ's observations and calculation rules. It is a management report, not an audited financial statement.
